principle: Presentation only. Bountiful remains authoritative for completion and payment.

ccc_north_leather_snowline.title: Leather for the Snowline
ccc_north_leather_snowline.body: Boots, straps, and pack harness wear out quickly once the roads start freezing. The outfitter is buying sound leather before the next trail party leaves.

ccc_north_snow_leopard.title: Cats Above the Pass
ccc_north_snow_leopard.body: Snow leopards have been stalking the high trail where pack animals cannot see them coming. The watch is paying for the immediate danger to be reduced.

ccc_north_grizzly.title: Bears Beyond the Pines
ccc_north_grizzly.body: A supply cache was torn open twice in one week. The tracks belong to grizzlies large enough that the quartermaster has stopped sending cooks to chase them off.

ccc_north_black_ice_coal.title: Lanterns for Black Ice
ccc_north_black_ice_coal.body: The last shelters before the black water are burning fuel faster than expected. Coal is worth more than coin when every light going out means another missing traveler.

ccc_east_moss_nursery.title: Moss for the Nursery
ccc_east_moss_nursery.body: The nursery is trying to keep young shade plants alive through a dry spell. Fresh moss will hold the damp better than another bucket carried by hand.

ccc_east_foliaath.title: Mouths in the Ferns
ccc_east_foliaath.body: Foliaaths have settled too close to a path used by gatherers. The warden would rather pay a hunter than wait for somebody to learn which leaves have teeth.

ccc_east_carniflore.title: The Carniflore Line
ccc_east_carniflore.body: Carniflores are appearing along the route between two camps. Nobody is asking you to clear the jungle—only to make one narrow road survivable again.

ccc_east_matriarch.title: The Matriarch in the Mangroves
ccc_east_matriarch.body: A slither matriarch has claimed the flooded route and smaller creatures have gathered around it. The watch wants the nest broken before the channel becomes unusable.

ccc_south_cactus_packers.title: Cactus for the Packers
ccc_south_cactus_packers.body: The caravan crews use cactus where greener settlements would waste cloth and timber. The tanner is buying clean cuttings for the next batch of travel gear.

ccc_south_rattlesnake.title: Rattles in the Brush
ccc_south_rattlesnake.body: Rattlesnakes have moved into the scrub around a busy watering place. The road watch is paying to make the approach safer for animals and people.

ccc_south_quake.title: Quakes on the Red Road
ccc_south_quake.body: Quakes have started crossing the old red road in daylight. The scout wants the route reopened before another caravan decides the detour is safer.

ccc_south_spirit_guide.title: Guides in the Dust
ccc_south_spirit_guide.body: Spirit Guides have been drifting onto the route after sunset, drawing travelers away from the markers. The watch wants the road quiet before the next expedition leaves.

ccc_west_apples_pressing.title: Apples for Pressing
ccc_west_apples_pressing.body: The early wind knocked half the orchard before the pickers were ready. Good apples are still being bought for the village presses and autumn tables.

ccc_west_grizzly_orchard.title: Bears at the Orchard
ccc_west_grizzly_orchard.body: Grizzlies have learned where the fallen fruit piles up. The keeper can tolerate a missing basket; a bear in the workers' path is another matter.

ccc_west_dread_hound.title: Hounds on the Old Road
ccc_west_dread_hound.body: Dread hounds have started following travelers between the abandoned farms. Clear enough of the pack that the watch can use the road again.

ccc_west_supreme_bonescaller.title: Bones at the Churchyard
ccc_west_supreme_bonescaller.body: A Supreme Bonescaller has been seen beyond the old graves. Nobody is asking for the churchyard back—only for the thing raising the dead around it to stop.
